blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.
blocks.zh: 深层搜索人员通过迭代检索和推理满足复杂的信息需要,在那里被检索的证据的相关性会影响下游的性能. 现有的重新排序器提高了检索的有效性,但在整个搜索轨迹中,如果被引用,则会带来很大的延迟性和成本。 我们引入了SOARS,一个无培训框架,利用系统一模型进行快速、校准的关联性估计。 在每一个搜索步骤上,SOARS都会从长文档中选择与查询相关的段落,并在一次呼叫中重新排序候选人,共同考虑原始问题和代理生成的子克瑞. 在浏览器Comp-Plus和WebShaper上的6个LLM主干线上,SOARS不断改进答案的准确性和证据召回,同时减少搜索呼叫、端到端的延迟和推论费用。 在浏览Comp-Plus上,它提高了GPT-5.4Mini的精度从73.9%提高到84.7%,同时将搜索电话从23个减少到14个,显示了System One重新排位对更高效和高效的深度搜索的潜力.

blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Deep search agents leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to address complex information needs through iterative rounds of searching, reading, and reasoning, deciding what to retrieve and read next based on the evidence collected throughout the search process ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Hsu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) . This paradigm supports reasoning-intensive tasks whose answers are not contained in any single document but must be assembled from evidence distributed across multiple documents ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . Given the limited interaction budgets of deep search agents, a central challenge in Web search is enabling these agents to surface the most relevant evidence effectively and efficiently.
blocks.zh: 深层搜索代理利用大语言模型(LLMs)通过迭代的搜索,阅读,推理等方式解决复杂的信息需求,根据在整个搜索过程中收集的证据决定下一步要检索和阅读什么(姚等人,2023年;许等人,2026年;黄等人,2025年;张等人,2024年a). 这种范式支持推理密集型任务,其答案并不包含在任何单一文件中,而必须从多份文件分发的证据中收集(Chen等人,2026年b)。 鉴于深度搜索人员的互动预算有限,Web搜索的一个中心挑战是使这些人员能够有效和高效地展示最相关的证据。

blocks.en: To provide deep search agents with relevant corpus evidence, prior work has explored several directions. Some approaches improve first-stage retrieval by training dense retrievers for agent-generated sub-queries ( Chen et al., 2026a ) or adapting lexical retrieval to long documents ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) . Another approach warm-starts the agent by decomposing the question and reranking results from complementary searches to construct an initial evidence context to guide iterative search and reasoning ( Rad et al., 2026 ) . Retrieval-aware agent control has also been explored to mitigate reasoning stagnation and reduce redundant searches by monitoring information coverage and search novelty ( Soudani et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches focus on retrieval, initialization, or trajectory control rather than reranking evidence throughout the search process.
blocks.zh: 为了向深层搜查人员提供相关物证,先前的工作探索了若干方向。 一些方法改进了第一阶段的检索,方法是为代理生成的子矿井培训密集的检索器(Chen等人,2026a),或根据长文件调整词汇检索(Hsu等人,2026年)。 另一种方法通过解析问题和重新排序使代理人温和地启动,其方法是通过补充搜索构建初步证据背景,以指导迭代搜索和推理(Rad等人,2026年)。 还探索了检索-意识剂控制,以通过监测信息覆盖和搜索新颖性来缓解推理停滞和减少冗余搜索(Soudani等人,2026年)。 然而,这些方法侧重于检索、初始化或轨迹控制,而不是在整个搜索过程中重新排列证据。

blocks.en: Reranking first-stage retrieval candidates is a common approach to improving retrieval effectiveness, typically using cross-encoders ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Nogueira et al., 2020 ) or LLM-based rerankers that assess relevance through prompting or reasoning ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Pradeep et al., 2023b ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Pradeep et al., 2023a ) . Recent studies have extended reranking to deep search agents ( Meng et al., 2026 ; Sharifymoghaddam and Lin, 2026 ) , demonstrating improvements in retrieval effectiveness and answer accuracy. Within a deep search agent, however, reranking is not a one-time operation but is often invoked at every search call along the trajectory, adding latency without substantially reducing the number of searches. Moreover, existing approaches typically rank candidates solely based on agent-generated sub-queries, overlooking the original question’s global information need, and rely on initial document tokens that may omit relevant evidence. Consequently, they improve retrieval effectiveness at the expense of efficiency, without substantially reducing the agent’s search effort.
blocks.zh: 重新排列第一阶段检索候选人是提高检索有效性的一种常见办法,通常使用交叉编码器(Nogueira和Cho, 2019年;Nogueira等人, 2020年)或基于LLM的重新排名器,通过提示或推理评估相关性(Sun等人, 2023年;Pradeep等人, 2023年b); Zhuang等人,2026;Pradeep等人,2023a). 最近的研究将重排范围扩大到了深度搜索代理(Meng等人,2026年;Sharifymoghaddam和Lin,2026年),表明在检索有效性和回答准确性方面有所改进. 然而,在一个深层搜索代理中,重新排序并不是一次性操作,而是经常在沿着轨迹的每次搜索呼叫中被引用,增加了潜伏性,而没有大大减少搜索次数. 此外,现有办法通常只根据代理生成的子程序对候选人进行排序,忽略了最初问题的全球信息需求,并依赖可能忽略相关证据的初始文件标志。 因此,它们以效率为代价,提高检索的有效性,同时又不大幅度降低代理商的搜寻努力。

blocks.en: Emerging System One models offer a promising direction for jointly improving retrieval effectiveness and efficiency. Unlike generative LLMs, these models produce structured, calibrated decisions in a single forward pass, enabling fast and cost-efficient inference ( dos Santos Barbosa, 2026 ; Deußer et al., 2026 ) . Recent work by Li et al. (2026) demonstrates that Jev, a System One model, achieves relevance judgments comparable to frontier models at substantially lower latency and cost. These capabilities are particularly valuable for deep search agents, where retrieval and reranking occur repeatedly. By prioritizing relevant evidence at each search step, System One reranking can expose agents to more useful information, potentially reducing search calls, agent reasoning overhead, and cost. However, adapting these models to deep search requires addressing long documents and the interplay between the global information need of the original question and the local information need of agent-generated sub-queries.
blocks.zh: 新兴系统 一种模式为联合提高检索效力和效率提供了一个有希望的方向。 与遗传性LLMS不同,这些模型在一次前传中产生结构化的,校准化的决定,能够快速和具有成本效益的推论(dos Santos Barbosa, 2026; Deußer等人, 2026). 李等人的近期著作. (2026年)表明,Jev作为系统一号模型,以低得多的延迟性和成本,实现了与前沿模型相当的相关性判断. 这些能力对于深层搜索人员特别有价值,因为那里反复出现检索和重新排序的情况. 通过在每个搜索步骤中确定相关证据的优先顺序,System One重排可以让特工们接触到更有用的信息,有可能减少搜索电话,代理推理管理费和成本. 然而,要使这些模型适应深度搜索,就需要处理长的文件,以及原始问题的全球信息需要与代理生成子库的本地信息需要之间的相互作用。

blocks.en: To this end, the main objective of this paper is to investigate how lightweight, repeated System One reranking improves the effectiveness and efficiency of deep search agents. Specifically, we address three research questions (RQs). (RQ1) How can System One models be adapted as in-loop rerankers in the context of deep search agents to improve retrieval effectiveness? (RQ2) How does System One reranking affect the agent’s downstream answer accuracy and evidence recall? (RQ3) What is its impact on overall agent efficiency in terms of latency and cost?
blocks.zh: 为此,本文的主要目的是调查轻量级,重复的System One重排如何提高深层搜索代理的效力和效率. 具体而言,我们处理三个研究问题。 (RQ1) 系统如何 在深层搜索代理的情况下,一个模型被改编为在Loop重排器,以提高检索的有效性? (RQ2) System One的重排如何影响代理商下游的回答准确性和证据召回? (RQ3)在耐久性和成本方面对整体代理效率有什么影响?

blocks.en: To investigate these questions, we introduce SOARS ( S ystem O ne A ssisted R eranking for Agentic S earch), a training-free framework that integrates System One reranking into deep search agents. SOARS represents long documents using query-relevant passages and reranks candidates in a single call, considering both the original question and the agent-generated sub-query. We evaluate SOARS on two deep search benchmarks, BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2026b ) and WebShaper ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , across six LLMs of varying families and sizes. Our results show that SOARS achieves retrieval effectiveness comparable to strong LLM-based rerankers while operating one to two orders of magnitude faster. At the agent level, SOARS prioritizes relevant evidence for subsequent reasoning, improving answer accuracy and reducing search calls across all backbones (Figure 1 ). Notably, GPT-5.4 Mini’s accuracy rises from 73.9% to 84.7% while search calls drop from 23 to 14. These improvements also translate into lower latency and cost, demonstrating how efficient, repeated reranking can improve the overall search trajectory.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些问题,我们引入了SOARS(S ystem O ne A ssisted R eledge for Agentic S earch),这是一个将System One重新排入深层搜索代理的无培训框架. SOARS代表使用查询相关段落的长文件,并在一次呼叫中重新排序候选人,既考虑原始问题,也考虑代理生成的子泻水. 我们用两个深度搜索基准来评价SOARS, 浏览器Comp-Plus(Chen等人, 2026b)和WebShaper(Tao等人, 2026年), 分为不同家庭和大小的六个LLMs. 我们的结果显示,SOARS在运行1到2个数量级的同时,实现了与强力LLM重排器相当的检索有效性. 在代理层面,SOARS为后续推理确定相关证据的优先顺序,提高答案的准确性,减少所有骨干之间的搜索呼叫(图1 ). 值得注意的是,GPT-5.4Mini的精度从73.9%上升到84.7%,而搜索电话则从23个下降到14个。 这些改进也转化为更低的耐久性和成本,表明反复的重新排序可如何高效地改善整个搜索轨迹.

blocks.en: Since an agent-generated sub-query q t q_{t} captures a local information need, matching it alone may overlook constraints in the original question Q Q . We therefore score documents against the composed query q ~ t = Q ⊕ q t \tilde{q}_{t}=Q\oplus q_{t} , accounting for both local relevance and global constraints. To accommodate the System One model’s bounded input and enable deeper reranking, we represent each document d d using a query-relevant passage of m m tokens. Rather than selecting the leading tokens, which may miss evidence deeper in the document, we select the span w w of m m tokens starting at the earliest occurrence of a non-stopword term from the agent-generated sub-query q t q_{t} . We use q t q_{t} alone for passage selection to focus on the agent’s immediate information need, while retaining Q Q during reranking to account for relevance to the global information need. We then prepend the document title, yielding d ^ = title ⁡ ( d ) ⊕ w \hat{d}=\mathrm{title}(d)\oplus w . This compact representation prioritizes relevant evidence while allowing more candidates to fit within the model’s input budget.

blocks.en: 3. Experiments
blocks.zh: 3. 实验

blocks.en: 3.1. Setup
3.1.1. Datasets

We evaluate SOARS on two benchmarks designed to assess deep search agents on complex, reasoning-intensive questions. BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2026b ) contains 830 complex questions and approximately 100K documents, with human-verified judgments distinguishing evidence documents needed to answer a question from gold documents that also contain the answer. WebShaper ( Tao et al., 2026 ) provides only gold documents. We randomly sample 200 questions and search the approximately 1M-document corpus released by ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 我们对SOARS的评价以两项基准为基础,旨在评估对复杂、推理密集问题的深入搜索人员。 浏览器Comp-Plus(Chen et al., 2026b)包含830个复杂问题和约100K文件,经人验证的判断区分出从同样包含答案的黄金文件中回答一个问题所需的证据文件. WebShaper(Tao等人,2026年)只提供黄金文件. 我们随机抽查了200个问题,并搜查了由Chen等人(2026a)发布的大约1M文件。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.1.2. Reranker Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.1.2. 调整基线

blocks.en: We compare SOARS against monoT5 ( Nogueira et al., 2020 ) and gpt-oss-120b with medium reasoning ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , following their use in prior deep search agent work ( Meng et al., 2026 ; Sharifymoghaddam and Lin, 2026 ) . We also include RankGPT ( Sun et al., 2023 ) with GPT-4.1 as its backbone, Qwen3-Reranker-4B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and GTE-ModernBERT ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . We run the latter two rerankers, along with monoT5, on a single NVIDIA A10 GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们比较SOARS与单 T5(Nogueira等人,2020年)和gpt-oss-120b,具有中度推理(OpenAI,2025年),此前曾用于深层搜索代理工作(Meng等人,2026年;Sharifymoghaddam和Lin,2026年). 我们还包括以GPT-4.1为骨干力量的RankGPT(Sun等人,2023年),Qune3-Rranker-4B(张等人,2025年),以及GTE-ModernBERT(张等人,2024年b). 我们运行后两台重排机,连同单T5在单NVIDIA A10 GPU上.

blocks.en: 3.1.3. Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1.3. 评价计量

blocks.en: We organize our metrics around the three research questions. For retrieval effectiveness (RQ1), we measure the recall of the reranked list that each search exposes to the agent. For agent effectiveness (RQ2), following prior work ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Hsu et al., 2026 ; Sharifymoghaddam and Lin, 2026 ) , we measure end-to-end Accuracy and Calibration Error with GPT-4.1 as the judge, and we trace gold/evidence through the trajectory with three recalls ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, surfaced recall is computed over the documents returned by the agent’s searches, previewed recall over those whose snippets the agent inspects, and behavior recall over those it opens or cites in its answer. For agent efficiency (RQ3), we report average search calls, per-query latency, and total cost. We calculate costs using submission-time API rates per million input, output, and cache-read tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕着三个研究问题组织我们的衡量标准。 对于检索的有效性(RQ1),我们测量每次搜索向代理商暴露的重新排序的列表的召回. 关于剂效(RQ2),在先前工作之后(Chen等人,2026年b); 陈等人,2026a; Hsu等人, 2026; Sharifymoghaddam and Lin, 2026), 我们用GPT-4.1作为裁判来测量端到端的精确度和校准误差, 我们通过轨迹追踪黄金/证据, 有三次回顾(Hsu等人, 2026). 具体地说,表面召回是在特工搜索后退回的文件中计算出来的,预先召回了特工检查过的片段,而行为召回了特工在答复中打开或引用的片段。 为了提高代理效率(RQ3),我们报告平均搜索电话、每间歇和总费用。 我们使用提交时间的API率计算每百万个输入,输出,以及缓存读音符的成本.

blocks.en: 3.1.4. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.1.4. 实施细节

blocks.en: We integrate SOARS inside the Pi-Serini agent framework ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) and study six LLM backbones of different families and sizes, namely GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 Mini, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Each backbone runs at medium reasoning effort under a 300-second per-query budget. Following ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) , we use BM25 ( k 1 = 25 k_{1}=25 , b = 1 b=1 ) as the first-stage retriever. For System One reranking, we employ Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , reranking the top k = 100 k=100 BM25 candidates at each search using document titles and query-relevant passages of m = 128 m=128 tokens. Jev costs $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . For the vanilla baseline without SOARS, we reuse Pi-Serini’s released trajectories for GPT-5.5, Opus 4.7, and Haiku 4.5 to evaluate answer accuracy using GPT-4.1 as the judge, while running the remaining backbones under identical settings.
blocks.zh: 我们把SOARS纳入Pi-Serini剂框架(Hsu等人,2026年),并研究不同家庭和大小的六个LLM骨干,即GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4 Mini、Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Haiku 4.5、双子座2.5 Pro和双子座2.5 Flash。 每个主干部门在每桶300秒的预算下进行中等推理。 随后(Hsu等人,2026年),我们使用BM25(k 1 = 25 k_{1}=25,b = 1 b = 1)作为第一级检索器. 对于系统 一次重新排队,我们雇用Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026),每次搜索时使用文档标题和查询相关段落的m=128m=128令牌,重新排好顶级k=100k=100BM25候选人. Jev每百万个输入符花费0.042美元,免费输出(TypeSafe AI,2026). 对于没有SOARS的香草基线,我们重新使用Pi-Serini发布的GPT-5.5,Opus 4.7和Haiku 4.5的轨迹,用GPT-4.1作为判断器来评估答案的准确性,同时在相同的环境下运行其余的骨干.

blocks.en: Figure 2. Effect of SOARS on per-query latency (a) and total cost (b) of deep search agents across six different LLM backbones.
blocks.zh: 图 2. SOARS对6个不同LLM主干线的深层搜索人员每节流速(a)和总成本(b)的影响。

blocks.en: 3.2. Results and Findings
blocks.zh: 3.2. 结果和结果

blocks.en: 3.2.1. RQ1: Retrieval Effectiveness
blocks.zh: 3.2.1. RQ1:检索有效性

blocks.en: We investigate how System One models can be adapted for in-loop reranking and compare their effectiveness against existing rerankers. We randomly select 50 BrowseComp-Plus questions comprising 1,044 sub-queries generated by GPT-5.4 Mini and their BM25 candidates. For each sub-query, SOARS and all baselines rerank the top 100 BM25-retrieved documents. We examine two query representations to assess global and local information needs in agentic search. The first uses the agent-generated sub-query to capture the immediate retrieval objective, while the second combines it with the original question to preserve broader context and constraints. We also compare two document representations, using either the leading tokens ( Lead ) or a passage starting at the earliest occurrence of a non-stopword sub-query term ( Overlap ), capturing evidence deeper in documents. These comparisons assess how query context and passage selection affect reranking effectiveness. Table 1 reports macro-averaged Recall@5, Recall@10, and reranking latency at the question level. The oracle prioritizes ground-truth gold or evidence documents within each BM25 candidate pool, establishing an upper bound on recall.
blocks.zh: 我们调查系统一号模型如何可以被调整为在轨重排,并将其有效性与现有的重排模型进行比较. 我们随机选择50个浏览器Comp-Plus问题,包括GPT-5.4 Mini及其BM25候选人产生的1 044个子溪。 对于每个子query,SOARS和所有基线重新排行前100位的BM25检索文件. 我们审查了两个查询说明,以评估在代理搜索中的全球和地方信息需求。 第一种是使用代理生成的子query来捕捉即时检索目标,而第二种是将其与原始问题结合,以保持更广泛的上下文和制约. 我们还比较了两个文件表述,要么使用主要符号(铅),要么使用最早开始使用非止语小词(Overlap)的段落,在文件中获取更深入的证据。 这些比较评估了查询背景和通道选择如何影响重新排序的有效性。 表1报告宏观平均召回@5、召回@10,并在问题层面重新排位。 预告片在每个BM25候选人才库中优先考虑地面真相黄金或证据文件,确定召回的上限。

blocks.en: Both query and document representations influence retrieval effectiveness. Combining the original question with agent-generated sub-query improves recall for most rerankers, while Overlap generally outperforms Lead . Under the combined setting, SOARS achieves the highest recall across all four metrics, reaching 47.2% gold and 44.4% evidence Recall@10. These results approach the oracle upper bound, demonstrating that System One reranking can be highly effective when jointly considering global and local information needs through focused document passages.
blocks.zh: 查询和文件说明都影响检索的有效性。 将原始问题与代理生成的子泻水相结合,对大多数重新排序者来说会提高召回力,而Overlap一般会超越铅. 在综合设置下,SOARS在所有四个度量衡中都实现了最高的召回,达到47.2%的黄金和44.4%的证据召回@10. 这些结果接近甲骨文的上限,表明在通过重点文件段落共同考虑全球和地方信息需求时,系统一的重排可以非常有效。

blocks.en: Beyond retrieval effectiveness, SOARS offers a substantial latency advantage. Although GTE-ModernBERT and monoT5 offer low per-query latency, SOARS achieves substantially higher recall with even lower latency. More notably, using overlap-selected passages and the original question combined with the sub-query, SOARS consistently outperforms RankGPT, the strongest LLM-based reranker, while requiring only 254 ms per query compared to 8.7 seconds. This combination of strong retrieval effectiveness and low latency makes System One reranking particularly suitable for repeated invocation throughout the agent’s search trajectory.
blocks.zh: 除了检索的有效性外,SOARS还具有很大的耐久优势。 虽然GTE-ModernBERT和单T5提供了低压的耐久性,但SOARS以更低的耐久性实现了高得多的召回. 更为显著的是,SOARS使用重叠选择的段落和原题与子query结合,一直比RankGPT,最强LLM基重排,而每个查询只需要254 ms,而8.7秒. 这种强有力的检索有效性和低延迟性相结合,使第一系统特别适合在整个代理搜索轨迹中重复引用。

blocks.en: 3.2.2. RQ2: Agent Effectiveness
blocks.zh: 3.2.2. RQ2: 代理有效性

blocks.en: We assess how integrating System One reranking into deep search agents affects end-to-end answer accuracy and evidence recall across two benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们评估将 " 系统一 " 重新纳入深层搜索代理如何影响端到端答案的准确性和两个基准的证据回顾。

blocks.en: BrowseComp-Plus. SOARS significantly improves answer accuracy across all LLMs, with relative gains ranging from 10.2% for GPT-5.5 to 63.8% for Gemini 2.5 Pro. These improvements are particularly pronounced for weaker agents, narrowing the performance gap with stronger backbones. Calibration error also consistently decreases, indicating more reliable confidence estimates. More importantly, the evidence recall analysis reveals where these gains originate. Despite using the same first-stage retriever and achieving similar surfaced gold recall, SOARS significantly improves previewed and behavior recall across all LLMs. For GPT-5.5, previewed gold recall increases from 72.9 to 88.7, while behavior gold recall rises from 56.1 to 79.0.
blocks.zh: 浏览Comp-Plus. SOARS大幅提高所有LLMs的答案精度,相对增益从GPT-5.5的10.2%到双子座2.5 Pro的63.8%不等. 这些改善对于较弱的行动者来说尤为明显,用更强大的骨干缩小了业绩差距。 校准误差也不断减少,表明信心估计数更加可靠。 更重要的是,证据回顾分析揭示了这些收益的来源。 尽管使用了相同的第一阶段检索器并实现了类似的表面金质回溯,SOARS大大改进了所有LLMs的预览和行为回溯. 对于GPT-5.5,预览金召从72.9增加到88.7,而行为金召从56.1增加到79.0.

blocks.en: These findings suggest that SOARS improves answer accuracy by promoting already-retrieved evidence into the documents agents preview, read, and cite. Furthermore, the average number of documents read increases significantly across all LLMs. As agents preview short document excerpts before selectively opening promising ones for full-text reading, this suggests that SOARS helps identify more useful evidence for deeper inspection. Notably, these gains are accompanied by fewer search calls (Figure 1 ), suggesting that better evidence prioritization reduces the need for additional retrieval.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,SOARS通过在文件代理人的预览、阅读和引用中推广已经获取的证据,提高了答案的准确性。 此外,在所有法学硕士课程中,阅读文件的平均数量大幅增加。 由于代理人在有选择地打开有希望的文件全文阅读之前先预览短文件节录,这表明SOARS有助于找出更有用的证据,以便进行更深入的检查. 值得注意的是,在取得这些成果的同时,搜索电话也减少了(图1),这表明,更好地确定证据的优先次序减少了额外检索的必要性。

blocks.en: WebShaper. The same pattern generalizes to WebShaper, where previewed and behavior recall increase significantly for every backbone, with significant accuracy improvements for most. The number of documents read also increases significantly across all backbones, suggesting more promising evidence is selected for deeper inspection. These findings confirm that SOARS consistently improves evidence utilization throughout the search trajectory, contributing to higher answer accuracy.
blocks.zh: 网易动漫. 同样的图案概括到WebShaper,其中预览和行为召回对每个骨干都有显著的提升,对大多数骨干有显著的准确性改进. 在所有骨干部门中,阅读的文件数量也大幅增加,这表明选择了更有希望的证据进行更深入的检查。 这些调查结果证实,SOARS在整个搜索轨迹中不断改进证据利用率,有助于提高答案的准确性。

blocks.en: 3.2.3. RQ3: Agent Efficiency
blocks.zh: 3.2.3. RQ3:代理效率

blocks.en: We evaluate the efficiency of per-step System One reranking across three dimensions, namely the number of search calls, per-query latency, and cost. We report results on BrowseComp-Plus, with broadly similar trends observed on WebShaper.
blocks.zh: 我们评价每个步骤系统一的效率,在三个方面重新排列,即搜索呼叫次数、每秒间隔和费用。 我们报告浏览CP-Plus的结果,在WebShaper上观察到大致相似的趋势。

blocks.en: Search calls. SOARS reduces search calls across all LLMs (Figure 1 ), especially for search-intensive agents, from 23 to 14 for GPT-5.4 Mini and 32 to 21 for Haiku 4.5. By promoting relevant documents to the top of the ranked list, SOARS helps agents identify and utilize useful evidence earlier in the search trajectory, reducing the need for subsequent searches.
blocks.zh: 搜索电话 SOARS将所有LLMs的搜索呼叫(图1),特别是搜索密集型代理,从23个GPT-5.4 Mini和32个Haiku 4.5的搜索呼叫减少到14个。 SOARS通过将相关文档推广到排名榜首,帮助代理商在搜索轨迹之前识别和利用有用的证据,从而减少了后续搜索的需要.

blocks.en: Latency. Despite adding a reranking call per search, SOARS reduces per-query latency for nearly all backbones (Figure 2 a), from 113 to 84 seconds for GPT-5.4 Mini and 100 to 73 seconds for Opus 4.7. Fewer search calls offset the reranker’s modest overhead, yielding a net latency reduction. These findings demonstrate that lightweight reranking can accelerate the overall search process by reducing the time spent on repeated search interactions.
blocks.zh: 即时. 尽管每次搜索都增加了一个重新排序的呼叫,但SOARS将几乎所有骨干(图2a)的每节间歇性降低,GPT-5.4 Mini从113秒降至84秒,Opus 4.7从100秒降至73秒. 搜索次数减少抵消了重新排名者微薄的间接费用,导致净延迟减少。 这些调查结果表明,轻量级重排可以通过缩短重复搜索互动的时间来加快整个搜索过程.

blocks.en: Cost. Total cost decreases for five of six backbones (Figure 2 b), particularly for expensive agents, from $247 to $119 for Opus 4.7 and $194 to $122 for Haiku 4.5. Reduced search effort offsets the minimal reranking cost, lowering overall agent compute. GPT-5.5 is the sole exception, with a modest cost increase potentially due to reading more evidence, contributing to higher accuracy (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 费用:六个主干线中的五个(图2b),特别是昂贵的代理商的费用总额从247美元降至119美元,Opus 4.7和Haiku 4.5则从194美元降至122美元。 搜索努力的减少抵消了最低的重新排序成本,降低了整体代理计算. GPT-5.5是唯一的例外,由于阅读了更多的证据,成本可能略有增加,因而提高了准确性(表2)。

blocks.en: 4. Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 4个 结论意见

blocks.en: We introduced SOARS, a training-free framework that adapts a System One model as a reranker inside the deep search agent’s iterative loop. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing the agent’s search calls, latency, and cost. These results show that fast, calibrated System One models make per-step reranking both effective and efficient, establishing them as a practical component for building deep search agents.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SOARS, 一个无训练框架, 将一个系统一号模型作为深层搜索代理的迭代循环的调整器。 在浏览器Comp-Plus和WebShaper上的6个LLM主干线上,SOARS不断改进答案的准确性和证据回顾,同时降低代理商的搜索电话、时间和成本。 这些结果显示,快速,校准的系统一模型使每步都有效和高效地重新排序,将其确立为建立深层搜索代理的实用组成部分.
